D: Gru has gone straight making jams and jellies until a secret agency recruits him to find a stolen formula.
P: Serve the mains when Gru and Lucy go undercover at Eduardo's Mexican restaurant in the mall.
S: Gru's new legit business making jams and jellies
Shortcrust rounds pressed into a patty tin, filled with Gru-worthy homemade berry jam, baked at 190C for 15 minutes.
Eduardo's restaurant at the shopping mall
Corn chips layered with black beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, topped with fresh salsa, guacamole and sour cream.
Agnes's fairy princess star fairy bread
Agnes's birthday party with a fairy princess

Soft white bread spread with butter and pressed into hundreds and thousands, cut into stars with a cutter and piled high for the party. Soften 100g butter until very spreadable. Spread it right to the edges of 12 slices soft white bread. Tip 1 jar hundreds and thousands onto a plate and press each slice butter side down into them so the top is fully coated. Cut out stars with a large star cutter, or cut into triangles with the crusts off. Pile onto a platter and serve straight away so the colours don't run.
M: the Mexican restaurant run by Eduardo
Chicken thighs braised in a red chilli and tomato sauce, shredded, rolled in tortillas, covered in more sauce and cheese, baked at 190C for 20 minutes.
Gru's underground lab full of minions

Spaghetti and beef meatballs simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, a big pot for the whole household. Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 30g grated parmesan, 2 crushed garlic cloves and salt. Roll into 20 meatballs and brown in olive oil. Soften 1 diced onion, add 2 tins crushed tomatoes, a pinch of sugar and a handful of basil and simmer 15 minutes. Add the meatballs, cover and simmer 40 minutes. Toss with 500g cooked spaghetti and serve with plenty of parmesan.
W: the purple minions on the loose
Grape jelly made up and set in clear cups for 3 hours, topped with whipped cream and banana slices like a minion's goggles.
K: Ripe bananas blended with cold milk, vanilla yoghurt, medjool dates and a pinch of cinnamon until thick, with a caramel drizzle in the glass. Peel 3 ripe bananas, slice and freeze for 2 hours. Blend with 500ml cold milk, 200g vanilla yoghurt, 4 pitted medjool dates and a pinch of cinnamon until thick and smooth. Drizzle 1 tbsp caramel sauce down the inside of each of 4 glasses, pour in the smoothie and top with a banana slice.

s.note: Gru's new legit business making jams and jellies
s.how: Simmer 300g mixed berries with 150g sugar and a squeeze of lemon for 15 minutes until jammy, then cool. Cut shortcrust into rounds, press into a patty tin and fill with the jam. Bake at 190C for 15 minutes until the pastry is golden.

s.note: Eduardo's restaurant at the shopping mall
s.how: Layer corn chips on a tray with black beans, grated cheddar and sliced jalapenos. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes until melted. Top with fresh salsa, smashed avocado and sour cream. Serve on the tray before anyone starts dancing.

m.note: the Mexican restaurant run by Eduardo
m.how: Toast and soak dried chillies, then blend with a can of crushed tomatoes. Simmer 800g chicken thighs in the sauce for 30 minutes and shred. Roll in flour tortillas, cover with more sauce and grated cheddar and bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream.

w.note: the purple minions on the loose
w.how: Make up 2 packets of grape jelly and pour into clear cups. Chill for 3 hours until set. Top with a swirl of whipped cream and two banana slices side by side like goggles. Serve to small helpers with a spoon each.

d.how: Peel 3 ripe bananas, slice and freeze for 2 hours. Blend with 500ml cold milk, 200g vanilla yoghurt, 4 pitted medjool dates and a pinch of cinnamon until thick and smooth. Drizzle 1 tbsp caramel sauce down the inside of each of 4 glasses, pour in the smoothie and top with a banana slice.
